briefdescription.para: Specialisation of DMat for ARingZZ matrices, backed by FLINT's fmpz_mat_t.

detaileddescription.para: Wraps an fmpz_mat_t and dispatches all dense arithmetic to FLINT's fmpz_mat_* routines. The class header warns that instances must not be exposed to the front end the fmpz_t coefficients are allocated by FLINT, not GC-managed, so the front-end GC could free them out from under the wrapper.
